import httpx

# Create a reusable client with base URL and bearer token
with httpx.Client(base_url="https://api.example.com") as client:
    # Make GET request to /users with bearer token authorization
    response = client.get("/users", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE"})
    
    print(f"Status Code: {response.status_code}")
    print(response.text)
